units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:6:7">Y. Snh. II, 20ᶜ</cite> <he>מלכא יתיב על ב׳ דידיה וכ׳</he> (read <he>בי ב׳</he>) the King sits in his palace, and thou sayest thou art the King?

senses.gloss: (genit. of βασίλεια, τὰ) of the palace, or of the royal affairs.
units: Gen. R. s. 93 פטרון ב׳ (πάτρων τῶν βασιλείων) superintendent of &c.
